description: Headless Renovate (no PR workflow; preset: homelab/default.json). It watches package.json and bun.lock. A new version lands on main as a commit; it reaches juno at the next `homelab-apply --tags mcp` (mcp-wiring clones main to /opt/claude-signal and runs `bun install`) and takes effect when the assistant's session restarts.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Transitive dependencies are not pinned in the manifests and move only through bun.lock: one commit a week that relocks them.

packageRules.description: A release is three days old before it is taken, so a broken release is usually withdrawn or fixed before it reaches main. This repository has no CI that tests a bump; the undo is a revert of the commit.
Every dependency shares package.json and bun.lock (read by the bun manager); separate branches conflict with each other and stall (seen in nutrak on 2026-08-01). One branch for all non-major updates.
